topics.title: Flight Test of Agni-V with MIRV Technology (Mission Divyastra)
topics.summary: India successfully conducted the first flight test of the endogenously developed Agni-V missile equipped with Multiple Independently Targetable Re-entry Vehicle (MIRV) technology, joining an elite group of nations possessing this capability.
topics.upsc_relevance: GS Paper III: Indigenization of technology, Security challenges, and strategic deterrence.

topics.title: High-Level Committee Recommendations on Simultaneous Elections
topics.summary: The Ram Nath Kovind-led High-Level Committee submitted its report recommending a two-phase framework to synchronize elections for the Lok Sabha, State Assemblies, and local bodies across India.
topics.upsc_relevance: GS Paper II: Constitutional amendments, Federal structure, and Electoral reforms.

topics.title: Environmental Impact Assessment of the Great Nicobar Island Project
topics.summary: Ongoing policy reviews highlight the ecological trade-offs of the Rs 72,000-crore Great Nicobar Project, focusing on forest clearance, the protection of the particularly vulnerable Shompen tribe, and marine biodiversity.
topics.upsc_relevance: GS Paper III: Conservation, environmental pollution and degradation, Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA).

topics.title: Operationalization Framework for the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC)
topics.summary: India and key regional partners signed preliminary framework agreements to advance the IMEC, focusing on multi-modal logistics, digital connectivity, and green energy export routes.
topics.upsc_relevance: GS Paper II: Bilateral, regional and global groupings, and agreements involving India.

topics.title: RBI's Expansion of Digital Rupee (e-₹) Interoperability with UPI
topics.summary: The Reserve Bank of India integrated Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) retail architecture with Unified Payments Interface (UPI) QR codes to increase adoption and financial inclusion.
topics.upsc_relevance: GS Paper III: Indian Economy, monetary policy, digital public infrastructure, and banking sector reforms.
